issues.what: FINDINGS misstates the mechanism behind r0_f1's 100th control percentile (and, by extension, the 5-min SPA p = 0.045 it dismisses as the same 'session-composition effect'). The text says 'the 57 skipped rows sit in sessions whose other units are better still'. The actual mechanism: 21 of the 57 skipped units are the only unit of their session (kept_n = 0), carrying +98,329 INR of net in total; fz_report.random_control and harness.selection_gain both drop such sessions (nothing to draw / gain = 0), so the control and SPA never see the big skipped winners. In the 33 mixed sessions the skipped units are worse (mean -2,680) than the kept (mean -520), so the kept set ranks at the 100th percentile while the pooled diff is -848. Conclusion (rule fails; both numbers reported) unchanged, but the definition does not match the code.
